slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize the total weekly profit, or is the goal to find any feasible production plan that simply meets the minimum profit requirement of 3000 yuan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether it is to maximize total weekly profit.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time, unused capacity, or a secondary weighted objective for manufacturing, assembly, or inspection processes.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The optimization objective is only to maximize weekly profit, with no secondary objective to minimize idle time weighted by process hourly costs.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle time or multi-objective weighting, and the user did not volunteer this hidden fact before the agent declared READY_TO_MODEL.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 hidden slot about idle-time minimization with cost-proportional weights remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the main profit-maximization objective and several constraint interpretations, but it missed the hidden secondary objective of minimizing process idle time with cost-proportional weights and then stopped prematurely.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
